footprints-indicator-tooltip:
Tooltip on the footprint indicator next to the page title. Parameters:
* $1 - number of distinct users who have read the page
footprints-page-title:
Title of Special:Footprints when a page is given. Parameters:
* $1 - the prefixed title of the page
footprints-backtopage:
Subtitle link back to the page being reported on. Parameters:
* $1 - a link to the page
footprints-readercount:
Sentence above the table of readers. Parameters:
* $1 - number of readers listed
footprints-empty: Shown when a page has no recorded readers yet.
footprints-nosuchpage:
Error shown when the requested page does not exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the requested page title as typed
footprints-top-intro: Intro text for Special:Footprints without a page parameter.
footprints-header-user:
{{Identical|User}}
Table column header: the user who read the page.
footprints-header-page:
{{Identical|Page}}
Table column header: the page that was read.
footprints-header-first: Table column header: timestamp of the user's first visit.
footprints-header-last: Table column header: timestamp of the user's most recent visit.
footprints-header-views: Table column header: total number of visits.
footprints-header-viewers: Table column header: number of distinct users who have read the page.
footprints-viewall: Link at the bottom of the footprint dialog, leading to Special:Footprints for the page.
footprints-dialog-subtitle:
Subtitle under the dialog's title. Parameters:
* $1 - number of distinct readers
* $2 - total number of views by all of them combined
footprints-dialog-loading: Placeholder text shown in the dialog body while its data is still being fetched.
footprints-dialog-updated-section: Heading of the dialog section comparing readers against the page's latest revision.
footprints-dialog-updated-line:
Body text of that section, when the last editor is known. Parameters:
* $1 - the edit's date/time, already formatted for display
* $2 - the editor's name
* $3 - number of readers who have not read the current revision yet
footprints-dialog-updated-line-unknown-e:
Same as footprints-dialog-updated-line, for the rare case the last editor cannot be shown. Parameters:
* $1 - the edit's date/time, already formatted for display
* $2 - number of readers who have not read the current revision yet
footprints-dialog-chart-title: Heading over the small bar chart of recent daily views.
footprints-dialog-chart-days:
Size of the chart's date window, shown beside its heading. Parameters:
* $1 - number of days
footprints-dialog-chart-today:
{{Identical|Today}}
Label for "today" both beside the chart's heading (paired with today's count) and as the last tick under the chart's x-axis.
footprints-dialog-sort-recent: Label of the dialog's sort tab that orders readers by most recent visit.
footprints-dialog-sort-frequent: Label of the dialog's sort tab that orders readers by number of visits.
footprints-dialog-sort-unread:
Label of the dialog's sort tab that filters to readers who have not read the current revision. Parameters:
* $1 - how many such readers there are
footprints-dialog-badge-you: Small badge on the current user's own row in the dialog's reader list.
footprints-dialog-badge-owner: Small badge on the row of the reader who created the page.
footprints-dialog-badge-last-editor: Small badge on the row of the reader who made the page's most recent edit.
footprints-dialog-badge-regular: Small badge on the row of a reader who has visited the page often (see $wgFootprintsRegularViews).
footprints-dialog-close:
{{Identical|OK}}
Label of the dialog's close button.
footprints-dialog-viewall:
Link at the bottom of the dialog's reader list, leading to Special:Footprints when the list was truncated. Parameters:
* $1 - number of readers not shown in the dialog
footprints-relative-now: Relative timestamp shown for a visit that happened moments ago.
footprints-relative-minutes:
Relative timestamp for a visit less than an hour ago. Parameters:
* $1 - number of minutes
footprints-relative-hours:
Relative timestamp for a visit less than a day ago. Parameters:
* $1 - number of hours
footprints-relative-days:
Relative timestamp for a visit less than a week ago. Parameters:
* $1 - number of days
echo-category-title-footprints:
{{doc-echo-category-title|footprints}}
Name of the notification category in Special:Preferences.
footprints-notification-header-first:
Notification sent to the creator of a page when the first person other than themselves reads it. Parameters:
* $1 - the reader's name, formatted for display
* $2 - the reader's name, for GENDER
* $3 - the title of the page
* $4 - the number of readers, always 1 for this message
footprints-notification-header-milestone:
Notification sent to the creator of a page when its reader count reaches a milestone (see $wgFootprintsNotifyMilestones). The creator is not counted. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the reader who crossed the milestone, formatted for display
* $2 - the same name, for GENDER
* $3 - the title of the page
* $4 - the number of readers
footprints-notification-link: Primary link of the notification, leading to the page that was read.
footprints-notification-link-list: Secondary link of the notification, leading to Special:Footprints for the page.
